notes: Three independent parallel-execution systems authored from scratch in three toolchains (numpy, C/pthreads, asyncio). Pipeline-parallel module: partition transformer-style layers across ranks by contiguous rank/world-size split, zero-init bias, point-to-point exchange of activations and gradients, with a tanh MLP forward/backward that the verifier confirms against an independent dense reference (forward, tol 1e-6) and against finite-difference gradients of the same forward on hidden world sizes/shapes. Assembly: a UPC-style shared-heap C program over pthreads that emits rank_<r>.out files (prefix rank_, suffix .out) on hidden rank counts; verifier recompiles the delivered C source and cross-checks each slice's count and deterministic total. Asyncio part: a semaphore-gated pool that never exceeds its cap, preserves order, and does not start never-arrived jobs after cancellation. Difficulty (18, hard) comes from reasoning_depth=3 (analytic gradient chain + partition/property math), quantitative_correctness=3 (bytes/gradient/sums must be exact), hidden_case_generalization=3 (verifier executes fresh hidden parameters/seeds in all three subsystems), tool_breadth=3 (three languages/runtimes), and debugging_ambiguity=2 (shape-vs-length signals under nondivisible world sizes, world>layers, malformed argv).
